name: editor-anthropic
purpose: Explicitly requested article suggestions: card annotation, literary editing and proofreading

retry.backoff: manual; bounded shared cooldown after HTTP 429

idempotency.key: owner + post + mode + source + context SHA256
idempotency.compensation: atomic owner/worker leases, recent result reuse, no automatic retry after ambiguous timeout

rate_limit.http_429: respect numeric Retry-After between 60 and 3600 seconds; no retry

degradation: Suggestions remain separate. Failure, incomplete JSON, stale content or failed integrity review preserves the original post. No automatic save/publication.

retention.provider_retention: governed by the Anthropic API account terms; no zero-retention guarantee
